description: Reads a classic 5-field cron expression (or @daily, @hourly, @reboot) and returns a plain-English description, the expanded form and the next run times in UTC.

count.description: How many upcoming runs to list. Defaults to 5.

expression.description: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, such as 15 3 * * 1, or a macro such as @daily.

from.description: ISO 8601 date and time to count from. Defaults to now.

name: cron_expression
title: Cron expression explainer
